text:
sasha: Hey support — user signed up via invite link and didn't get the welcome credit. They verified email and completed GPay 3DS. Payment shows success. account_id=781234. Can someone triage? @eli @jordan
eli: On it. Can you paste the user_id (numeric) and the exact email they used? Also did they use SSO or an alias (+tag)?
sasha: user_id=781234, email=gabi+work@example.com, no SSO, came from invite link. Region reported as FR (IP 2a03:...). Screenshot of payment success attached by user.
payments-bot: gateway callback: tx=tx_7612 status=success 3ds=Y bin=411111 bin_country=US ip_country=FR fraud_score=12
jordan: Hmm bin_country != ip_country and fraud_score=12 — autogrant likely blocked by BIN_COUNTRY mismatch rule. Invite flows sometimes get hit if card BIN is different (virtual cards, GPay). @eli can you pull autogrant logs for 781234?
eli: Pulling logs — autogrant returned: "GATE_BIN_COUNTRY_MISMATCH". Because email is a plus-alias and user came through an invite link, flow didn't mark them as trusted corporate. Given 3DS verified and payment success, I'll perform a manual grant and leave notes for PM.
eli: Running manual grant now. Command I used: ```
./admin/grants --manual --user 781234 --grant welcome_credit --amount 1000 --reason "manual: bin-country mismatch; 3DS verified; invite link + email alias"
```
ops-bot: Manual grant applied: grant_id=G-99231 applied_at=1719991275 credits=1000 operator=eli
sasha: Confirmed — user reports welcome credit visible on their dashboard. I'll reply to them and close the loop. Thanks! :thumbsup:
jordan: Filing follow-up to relax gating for invite flows + strong 3DS signals: created infra issue #456 (repo: infra/rules).
